about_the_game:
Crystallium is a rhythm game where you explore the world with different companions and fight against monsters from the dungeon.


Sync Your Actions to the Beat

In Crystallium, each song becomes a thrilling battle against deadly monsters. Get ready to test your skills by pressing keys and moving your mouse simultaneously. Like other vertical-scrolling rhythm games, you'll use assigned keys to hit the notes within their respective areas. However, in Crystallium, you can utilize not just one key per area, but your entire keyboard! Moreover, when bullets and traps appear, swiftly move your character away using your mouse to ensure your team's victory in battle.

Crystallium offers four difficulty levels: "Crescent", "Lunar", "Astral", and "Bloodlust". Whether you're a beginner or a pro in rhythm games, you'll be able to enjoy a variety of levels. It also features various well-known and small and growing artists across the rhythm game scene, with more than 20 songs featuring a wide variety of genres available.


Forge Bonds and Brave the Unknown

As the main character living in a village, you have become a warrior upon reaching your 18th birthday. However, your adventure takes an unexpected turn when your friend's invitation to explore the dungeon leads to a dire situation. To save your friend, two other warriors, Lycurgus and Vermithrax, step in and extend a helping hand, inviting you to an adventure...

Unlock stories, challenges, rewards and meet different characters through “Steps” in the map at anytime you want. Not in the mood to finish the main story? You can always leave them aside and do mini-tasks from other characters for rewards.

Conquer Dungeons and Uncover New Tracks

Embark on dungeon exploration to uncover new songs and rewards. Whenever you encounter a monster, defeat it by completing a song. Be careful though, as restrictions might appear to make your exploration more difficult!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Core i5-2400 or equivalent
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD 630 or equivalent (2 GB)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible
  • VR Support: Not supported

Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system

short_description: Crystallium is a furry-themed rhythm game where you build a team of warriors to fight monsters. Vanquish corruption from the dungeons and unearth the ancient mystery that has faded from everyone's memory.
